title: eval-gate gate
description: Thresholds for a whole run. A gate decides pass or fail; a case decides pass or fail. The normative rules live in src/evalgate/validate.py.

min_pass_rate.description: Fraction of cases that must pass. 90 here is an error: it reads as 9000%.

max_total_cost_usd.description: Model plus judge cost. 0 disables the cost check. An unpriced model fails the check rather than guessing.

max_failures_per_grader.description: Per-grader failure allowance. A misspelt grader name is a warning: that limit could never fire.
